SECTION E: Case Study Based (4 Marks)

Q37. Case Study 2: The Hot Air Balloon
Balloon height = 100 m. Angle of elevation from point P is 60°, later reduces to 30° after moving horizontally.
(i) Draw labelled diagram. (1)
(ii) Find horizontal distance from P when angle is 60°. (1)
(iii) (a) Find horizontal distance travelled. (Use √3 = 1.73) (2) OR
(b) If height were 100√3 m instead of 100 m, find horizontal distance in first position (60°). (2)

Answer / Solution:
(ii) tan60° = 100/x => x = 100/√3
(iii)(a) At 30°: tan30° = 100/y => y = 100√3
Distance travelled = y - x = 100√3 - 100/√3
Using √3 = 1.73: x ≈ 57.8, y ≈ 173.0
Travel ≈ 173.0 - 57.8 = 115.2 m (approx)
Exact: 200/√3 m
(iii)(b) If height = 100√3:
tan60° = (100√3)/x => √3 = (100√3)/x => x = 100 m
Answers:
(ii) 100/√3 m
(iii)(a) ≈ 115.2 m OR (b) 100 m
